14 Appendix: Keywords Phys/Log (P/L-List) for Powertrain
Domain
The following table defines a P/L-list for the Powertrain Domain and can be used as
input for the rules described in chapter 7.1.
The
keyword
abbreviations
are
a
subset
of
the
ones
defined
in
AUTOSAR_MOD_AISpecification [3] and cover physical as well as logical aspects.

Keyword Abbreviation
Description

acceleration

address

angle

area

counter

factor

flag, bit, boolean, binary signal

frequency

electric current
Idx
index
N
(rotational) speed
Nr
number
P
pressure
Posn
position
Pwr
power
R
resistance
Rat
ratio, duty cycle
St
state, status
T
temperature
Ti
time, duration
Tq
torque
U
voltage
V
velocity
Vol

W
work
